Two Pakistan Army pilots killed in training aircraft crash

A Pakistan Army training aircraft crashed near Quetta, resulting in the deaths of two pilots. The crash was reportedly due to a technical fault. Following the incident, Pakistan's President and Prime Minister expressed their condolences.
